hypothesis: Small coefficient mutations around the independently reproduced 5-violation upstream seed can repair the known violating taxi edges without introducing enough new violations to prevent a result below 3.
rationale: The pinned seed vector is exact at 5 violations over all 7,000,602 inequalities, leaving only five observed failures. A deterministic one- and two-coordinate neighborhood is a focused test of whether those failures are locally repairable; it avoids million-vector coefficient churn and uses the actual violating-edge structure as information.
expected_information_gain: Determines whether the 5-violation basin has a locally repairable neighborhood. A target result would open adversarial/generalization verification; failure would close small local repair around this seed and favor a different potential family.
method: Load the locked upstream source and adapter. Use the five exact violating edge indexes from kserver-n7-streaming-mp-001. Enumerate the deduplicated neighborhood consisting of every active coefficient replacement by each value in -5..5 and every pair of active coefficients changed by deltas in {-2,-1,+1,+2} when in range. Compute exact canonical Potential values only at the endpoints of those five frozen edges, rank candidates by remaining violations on that edge subset and mutation size, then run the unmodified pinned stage-D evaluator sequentially with eight streaming workers on the best two mutated candidates. Stop immediately at the first full result below 3.
metric: primary: exact full circle_taxi_k4_m6 violations_k; screening proxy: exact violations among the five seed-violating edges
metric_relation_to_true_objective: Only a completed full taxi result with violations_k < 3 reaches the frozen target. Five-edge screening is a diagnostic filter and can miss newly introduced violations; it is never reported as the primary result.

configuration.neighborhood: one replacement over -5..5 plus two-coordinate deltas {-2,-1,+1,+2}
configuration.screening: exact canonical Potential on ten endpoints of five frozen edges

compute_budget.cpu: one screening process plus eight bounded streaming potential workers per sequential full candidate
compute_budget.memory_intent: no circle B cache; bounded streaming only

kill_condition: Stop at the first full exact result below 3, after two full finalists, at 2400 seconds, or at a precise runtime failure. Do not infer infeasibility from the neighborhood or screening proxy.

baseline_comparison.expected_relation: strict target progress only if a full finalist scores below 3

previous_best_comparison.expected_relation: mutations must improve the independently reproduced 5-violation primary score

repetition_justification: This is a new edge-targeted local-repair family informed by an independently reproduced primary score and its five violating edges. It is not a repeat of the upstream staged search, cache search, or untargeted worker-count experiments.
